mapper.insert: insert into biz_project_blacklist (target_type, target_id, kind, value, reason, create_by, create_time) values (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{kind}, #{value}, #{reason}, #{createBy}, now()) on conflict (target_type, target_id, kind, value) do nothing
mapper.delete: delete from biz_project_blacklist where id = #{id} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.select: select id, target_type, target_id, kind, value, reason, create_by, create_time from biz_project_blacklist where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} order by id desc
